Calibration objective: deviation from the initial state

Source: R/score.R
score_table.Rd

Scores how far a model run drifts from its initial state, in the spirit of Morell et al. (2026, Ecol. Model. 520:111688) and calibrar's lnorm2. Every series – one group x age class x tracer (Nums, StructN, ResN), or the biomass of one living group – is compared with its initial (t = 0) value on the log scale, as \(log(x + tiny) - log(x_0 + tiny)\).

Usage

score_table(
  ts,
  biomass = NULL,
  tolerance = 0.2,
  summary = "snapshot",
  window_years = 2,
  tiny = 0.01,
  exclude = character(),
  method = c("band", "lnorm2"),
  weight = 1,
  target_factor = 1
)

compute_score(ts, ...)

Arguments

ts

Tracer table with columns group, age, time (seconds), StructN, ResN and Nums, raw (one row per box and layer) or aggregated.

biomass

Biomass table with columns group, time (seconds) and Biomass, e.g. from read_biomass_index(), or NULL (default) to score the age-structured tracers only.

tolerance

Half-width of the no-penalty band: one number for the three age-structured tracers, or a vector named by tracer (Nums, StructN, ResN and, to score biomass, Biomass).

summary

Statistic each series is scored on over the window (see stat in window_values()): one for every tracer, or a vector (a list to pass functions) named by tracer, the tracers left out using "snapshot".

window_years

Length of the scoring window in years, counted back from the last output step.

tiny

Offset keeping zero values finite on the log scale.

exclude

Names of the groups left out of the score (their tracers and their biomass).

method

"band" (default) penalizes the excess beyond the tolerance band, averaged over the scored values; "lnorm2" the squared log ratio to the target, summed over them, as Morell et al. (2026).

weight

Weight of the penalty of each series: one number for every tracer, or a vector named by tracer, the tracers left out weighing 1. With method = "lnorm2", a named weight also sets the tracers scored, among Nums, StructN, ResN, Weight and Biomass.

target_factor

Factor applied to the initial value to get the target (Morell et al.'s \(b\)): one number for every tracer, or a vector named by tracer, the tracers left out using 1.

...

Arguments passed on to score_table().

Value

score_table(): a data frame with one row per group x age x tracer and its penalty (age is NA for biomass). compute_score(): the total score, a single number.

Details

Each series is first reduced to its scored values over the last window_years years of the run by window_values(), with the statistic summary gives for its tracer. Scored values within [1 - tolerance, 1 + tolerance] times the initial value are not penalized; outside that band only the excess beyond the band edge is squared, which keeps the objective continuous at the edge. The squared excesses are averaged over the scored values of each series. score_table() returns that penalty per series, compute_score() their sum.

method = "lnorm2" scores instead the objective function of Morell et al. (2026) as implemented in their calibration code (calibrar's lnorm2, targets built from the initial state): no tolerance band, the squared log ratio \((log(x + tiny) - log(b x_0 + tiny))^2\) is summed over the scored values of each series. Its tracers are the ones weight names, by default those of Morell et al.: the weight-at-age (Weight, wet weight of the average individual in kg, (StructN + ResN) * 5.7 * 20 / 1e6) and, when biomass is given, the Biomass. For the unfished phase of their calibration, the biomass target is the initial biomass times \(b = 1.3\) (target_factor = c(Biomass = 1.3)).

With either method, the penalty of a series is multiplied by the weight of its tracer, and the initial value by its target_factor.

The age-structured tracers are aggregated over boxes and layers first (see aggregate_time_series()), so ts can be the raw table of create_time_series_biomass() or its aggregate. Biomass series that start at zero are left out.

References

Morell, A., et al. (2026). Ecological Modelling 520:111688.

Examples

year <- 365 * 86400
time <- seq(0, 5 * year, by = 73 * 86400)
ts <- data.frame(
  group = "Walleye", age = 1, time = time,
  StructN = 100, ResN = 300 * exp(time / (5 * year)), Nums = 1e6
)
score_table(ts)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   group   age   tracer  penalty
#>   <chr>   <chr> <chr>     <dbl>
#> 1 Walleye 1     StructN   0    
#> 2 Walleye 1     ResN      0.525
#> 3 Walleye 1     Nums      0    
compute_score(ts, tolerance = c(Nums = 0.5, StructN = 0.2, ResN = 0.2))
#> [1] 0.5250338
# Morell et al. (2026): weight-at-age, no band, summed squared log ratio
score_table(ts, method = "lnorm2")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   group   age   tracer penalty
#>   <chr>   <chr> <chr>    <dbl>
#> 1 Walleye 1     Weight   0.836
